title: Inquiry Session
description: A compact continuity record. Save visible prompts, decisions, and outputs; do not store hidden chain-of-thought.

dispersal_seed.description: The seed this session was dispersed under (arena branch label or its hex form), copied from the packet's assignment receipt. Optional so that the rows written before 2026-11-15 stay valid: of 828 sessions only 74 (8.9%) record a seed anywhere, and they do it in prose. Without this field the archive runs a randomized assignment every session and then discards the assignment, so no path-to-judgment question can be joined at scale.

assigned_role.description: The inquiry role belief_state.assign_session_role gave this seed. A pure function of the seed: measured over 437 questions x 18 seeds = 7,866 cells with zero content overrides. Only 35 of 828 sessions (4.2%) record it in prose.

offered_target_question_id.description: The question the packet offered as its target (--packet auto resolves it from the seed; measured to differ across seeds, changing which question is answered at all). Kept apart from question_ids, which is what the session chose to work on: the difference between the two is the only place a path effect on direction is observable.

offered_reference_mode.description: The reference mode the packet offered. Kept apart from prompt_template, which is what the session actually used.

generator.description: Model/tool label if known; omit if unknown.
